scope: one fixed ratio D with nested oriented interval graphs

history_transition.naturality: B_j i_ji=B_i because old interval labels and kernels are unchanged
history_transition.monotonicity: C_i<=C_j when support diameter and total edge length are nondecreasing

augmented_transition.target_inclusion: identity on history plus zero-padding on persistent chord coordinates

cycle_metric.ambient_edge_form: W_i=diag(w_e:e in E_i) with w_e>0 and persistent old weights
cycle_metric.forest_change: if F_i'=F_i T then Q_i'=T^* Q_i T
cycle_metric.forest_independence: the norm of the represented cycle is unchanged when coordinates transform by T^-1
cycle_metric.cutoff_compatibility: old-cycle Gram is the principal block of Q_j when old fundamental cycles persist and old edge weights are unchanged
cycle_metric.calibration_warning: choice of edge weights remains structural/synthetic until source covariance is supplied

next_required_object.acceptance: prove bounded L_i S_i, or introduce source-derived cutoff weights and a completed Hilbert direct/inverse limit with bounded augmented observer
